description: This header file defines APIs for interacting with the TR-069 Device.IP.Diagnostics.TraceRoute.RouteHops object, including functions to get hop host names, addresses, error codes, and RTT times within a device's IP diagnostics implementation.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHops_Host
methods.description: Retrieves the host name, or IP address if DNS resolution is unavailable, for a hop in the traceroute.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHops_HostAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the IP address of the host for a specific hop, possibly including a reverse DNS hostname.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHops_ErrorCode
methods.description: Fetches the ICMP error code associated with a particular hop, indicating issues like timeouts or unreachable hosts.

methods.name: get_Device_IP_Diagnostics_TraceRoute_RouteHops_RTTimes
methods.description: Obtains a comma-separated list of round-trip times (in milliseconds) for probes sent to a specific hop.
